description: A festival artistic director must authorize a one-night live cine-concert presentation of The Last Orchard and lock the projection, recording, credit, ensemble, and rehearsal arrangements.

shared_context.S1: The festival plans to present The Last Orchard with a live commissioned score at the Calder Cinema on October 18.
shared_context.S2: The festival's draft plan calls for a digital cinema package, two public screenings, audience photography, a standard courtesy credit, a 10-player ensemble, and a 3:00 PM-4:00 PM rehearsal.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to approve the final presentation plan.
shared_context.S4: At production lock, the festival's standard roundtable requires the artistic director to ask rights and music leads to report any confirmed changes before the plan is approved.

PF1.text: Julian reviewed the revised license email from the Orchard Estate this morning. It permits exactly one public screening, requires 35mm projection, prohibits any audience or house recording, and requires the credit line 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate'; he has not uploaded the email to the shared production packet yet.

PF2.text: Selene received the signed musicians' agreement after the rehearsal plan was circulated. It requires a 14-player ensemble, and the conductor has approved only a 4:30 PM-5:30 PM rehearsal on October 18; Selene has not yet added the agreement to the shared call sheet.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly one public screening must be authorized.
All audience and house recording must be prohibited.
The credit line must read exactly 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate'.
The live score must use a 14-player ensemble.
The rehearsal must be scheduled for exactly 4:30 PM-5:30 PM on October 18.
A rights-compliance commitment must be recorded.
An ensemble-and-rehearsal commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C3: decisions['recording_policy'] in ['No audience or house recording', 'no audience or house recording', 'No audience or house recording permitted', 'no audience or house recording permitted', 'Audience and house recording prohibited', 'audience and house recording prohibited', 'no audience or house recording of any kind', 'No audience or house recording of any kind']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'document_upload' and c['target'] == 'Selene' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'document_upload' and c['target'] == 'Julian' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: decisions['rehearsal_block'] in ['October 18, 4:30 PM-5:30 PM', 'October 18, 4:30 PM - 5:30 PM', 'October 18, 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM', '4:30 PM-5:30 PM on October 18', '4:30 PM - 5:30 PM on October 18', '4:30 PM to 5:30 PM on October 18']

decisive_facts.why: The revised license changes projection from digital to 35mm, reduces the screening count from two to exactly one, changes recording from allowed to prohibited, replaces the standard credit with 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate', and requires a rights-compliance commitment.

The signed musicians' agreement changes the ensemble from 10 to exactly 14 players, moves the rehearsal from 3:00 PM-4:00 PM to October 18, 4:30 PM-5:30 PM, and requires an ensemble-and-rehearsal commitment.
